original_report: 套餐优惠：买二赠一应免最便宜的一份，却免了最贵的一份。
diagnosis: 赠品/免费项应挑价值最低的单位，而非最高。
before_source:
def meal_deal(prices, buy, free):
    s = sorted(prices, reverse=True)
    total = sum(s)
    disc = sum(s[:free])
    return total - disc

+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@

     s = sorted(prices, reverse=True)
     total = sum(s)
-    disc = sum(s[:free])
+    disc = sum(s[-free:])
     return total - disc
